transcript: I have been having severe chest pain for the past two hours. The pain is going to my left arm and I am also sweating. I am also having difficulty breathing. I am very scared.
reason: Patient described: chest pain, breathlessness, sweating. Symptoms present for 2 hours. Severity assessed as severe. Red flag rules triggered: cardiac_emergency. Multi-symptom rules matched: Cardiac Cluster. Marked EMERGENCY: immediate specialist attention required — Cardiology.

rag_rules_retrieved.reasoning: Acute chest pain with associated symptoms (sweating, breathlessness, arm/jaw radiation) strongly indicates Acute Coronary Syndrome — medical emergency.
Any patient describing chest pain, especially with: radiation to arm/jaw, sweating, breathlessness, or nausea.
